SDN.note: The 2026 Banking Regulation Act and the continuity rule are not stated to cover payment systems, e-money or provider licensing.
Nothing on consumer protection in digital finance.
Nothing on government payments to people.
The Central Bank's ISO 22301 requirement binds banks only, a sector rule that places nothing.

systems.system: Central Bank of Sudan Disaster Recovery Centre

SDN.note: The Central Bank's recovery centre is placed only in one of the states and said not fully ready when the war began, so no distant site in service; the continuity protocol is an analyst's opinion and no test is stated.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
Nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
